# Research 1: mechanics

## Mechanics

Rolling Slam slams twice: its aftershock is a second hit after a short delay.[^m1] Earthquake's aftershock lands after a longer delay, and only once.[^m2]

- i1a-1 | Rolling Slam | skill | role: layer | needs: Warrior, a mace | conflicts: none | lookup_game_data gem "Rolling Slam" | modelled | on: r1-a-1, r1-a-3
- i1a-2 | Fist of War | support | role: scaler of Rolling Slam | needs: a slam skill | conflicts: none | lookup_game_data gem "Fist of War" | modelled | on: r1-a-1
- i1a-3 | Elemental Focus | support | role: scaler of the hit | needs: any | conflicts: forbids ailments | lookup_game_data gem "Elemental Focus" | modelled | on: none
- i1a-4 | Earthquake | skill | role: layer | needs: Warrior, a mace | conflicts: none | lookup_game_data gem "Earthquake" | modelled | on: r1-a-2
